scales.pure: NBA-equivalent pts/100 (pure, prior-free series, calibrated to the public DataBallR ridge); college/G-League translated.
scales.box: NBA-equivalent pts/100 on the daily-refit box+EPM basis the prior-informed solve shrinks toward — its own honest scale, which reads cooler than the board (especially on defense). College/G-League legs are raw mu_box + calibration offset.
scales.latent: NBA-equivalent pts/100 on the cross-league fused (latent) state, which exists only for players who actually changed leagues; every other row is that player's prior-informed number, aliased — the same definition the Explorer uses.

tables.title: Rookies
tables.sub: Players in their first NBA season (2025-26).

tables.title: Draft
tables.sub: Each pick's MEASURED pre-draft season — the college / G-League year they were drafted out of, on our NBA-equivalent scale — not a projection and not what they became, so four-year seniors routinely outrank one-and-done lottery picks. Internationals omitted; pick # shown for contrast.
